神经退行性疾病.abstract: Despite traumatic brain injury (TBI) being a leading cause of death and disability in the United States, there is currently no FDA-approved medication that can prevent, heal, or reverse brain damage caused by TBI. TBI is caused by primary and secondary brain damage resulting in loss of neurons, astrocytic gliosis, and microglial activation which culminate in complex neurological disorders. The goal of the current study was to investigate the neuroprotective potential for Creatine Hydrochloride (C-HCl) supplementation following TBI in wild-type mice. Four C-HCl supplementation paradigms were examined including both 7 day pre-injury and 14-day post-injury treatments consisting of the following: 1) water/water, 2) water/C-HCl (100 mg/kg), 3) C-HCl (100 mg/kg)/C-HCl (100 mg/kg), 4) C-HCl (100 mg/kg)/C-HCl (450 mg/kg). Following controlled cortical impact (CCI) injury at a parietal location, measures of tissue and cellular (neuronal and glial) damage were assessed at 14 days post-injury (dpi). At 14 dpi, there were no significant effects on gross anatomical cavitation, tissue loss, third ventricle expansion, or systemic fluid biomarkers with any treatment group, though female mice exhibited larger baseline lesion boundaries overall compared to male mice. However, microstructural evaluation revealed a profound and sex-dependent effect of C-HCl supplementation in the hippocampus with female mice showing reduced neuroinflammation and male mice displaying reduced neurodegeneration (Fluoro-Jade C staining of neurons) across the CA1 and dentate gyrus (DG) compared to placebo control. 神经退行性疾病.title: Neuronal expression of E2F4DN restores adult neurogenesis in homozygous 5xFAD mice via TrkB signaling
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Background: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is increasingly recognized as a disorder that disrupts brain plasticity long before extensive neuronal loss occurs, including early impairment of adult neurogenesis. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying these alterations remain poorly understood. Methods: Neuronal expression of E2F4 carrying the Thr249Ala/Thr251Ala mutation (E2F4DN) was achieved using an AAV.PHP.eB vector in the 5xFAD mouse model of AD. Neurogenic potential was assessed by immunohistochemistry and quantitative PCR (qPCR) targeting neurogenesis-associated markers. For in vitro experiments, neural stem cells (NSCs) isolated from the subventricular zone (SVZ) were exposed to conditioned media from primary cortical neurons expressing E2F4DN, with or without pharmacological inhibitors. NSC proliferation and differentiation were evaluated by immunocytochemistry and qPCR. Results: Neuronal expression of E2F4DN restored the proliferative and differentiation capacity of NSCs in 5xFAD mice both in vivo and in vitro. Pharmacological inhibition of TrkB signaling abolished the pro-neurogenic effects of E2F4DN-conditioned medium, whereas direct activation of TrkB in NSCs recapitulated these effects. Conclusions: These findings identify a mechanism by which neuronal dysfunction in AD compromises neurogenesis through impaired TrkB-mediated signaling. The results uncover a previously underappreciated paracrine communication between neurons and NSCs and highlight neuronal E2F4DN expression and TrkB modulation as promising therapeutic strategies to counteract early neurogenic deficits in AD.

神经退行性疾病.title: Early Insulin Signaling Defects and Oxidative Stress Kinase Activation Precede Tau Pathology in PS19 Tau Transgenic Mice
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Pathological tau accumulation is a hallmark of Alzheimers disease (AD), yet its relationship with impaired insulin signaling remains unclear. Previously, we reported altered IRS1 phosphorylation reduced p IR beta, and GLUT3 expression in young AD transgenic mice prior to overt pathology. Here, we investigated insulin signaling and oxidative stress pathways in the Tau P301S (PS19) mouse model. We found that alterations in phospho IRS1, phospho IR beta, and the glucose transporters GLUT3 and GLUT4 occur before pathogenic tau deposition. In stable tau expressing human neuronal cell lines, tau expression was similarly associated with impaired insulin signaling. Concurrent dysregulation of insulin signaling and activation of oxidative stress responsive kinases, accompanied by increased microglial abundance, were evident in 2 month old PS19 mice and persisted into adulthood. Together, these findings demonstrate that insulin signaling abnormalities and oxidative stress kinase activation are early and sustained features of PS19 tauopathy, preceding the onset of overt neuropathology.

神经退行性疾病.title: Dopaminergic Medication Improves Force Control and Modifies Motor Unit Activity During the Steadiest and Least Steady Periods in Parkinsons Disease
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Parkinsons disease (PD) impairs steady force production, but how dopaminergic medication alters force control and the motor unit (MU) activity is unclear. This study examined force steadiness and biceps brachii MU behavior in 16 people with PD ON and OFF dopaminergic medication. Participants performed sustained isometric elbow flexion contractions at 5%, 10%, 15%, and 25% of maximum voluntary contraction (MVC). High density surface electromyography was decomposed into MU spike trains. Force steadiness and MU discharge properties were quantified during nonoverlapping 7-s steadiest and least steady contraction periods, whereas MU coherence was assessed across the force plateau. In the ON state, force steadiness improved by 17_19% during both contraction periods at 5_15% MVC. MU interspike interval variability decreased by [~]12% across all forces during the least steady contraction period and by 17% at 15% MVC during the steadiest contraction period, whereas mean MU discharge rate was unchanged. Recruitment thresholds were higher at 10% and 25% MVC in the ON state, whereas derecruitment thresholds did not differ. Across the entire plateau, alpha- and tremor-band MU coherence decreased by 14% and 18%, respectively, whereas delta-band coherence was unchanged. These findings demonstrate that dopaminergic medication improves both the steadiest and least steady periods of low-force control, accompanied by reduced MU discharge variability and frequency-specific changes in plateau-wide MU coherence rather than changes in mean discharge rate. Resolving within-contraction variation reveals medication-sensitive features of force control that are obscured by conventional plateau-wide analyses, providing a new approach for evaluating motor output in PD.

神经退行性疾病.title: Frequency-Resolved Connectivity Graphs for EEG-Based Classification of Alzheimer and Frontotemporal Dementia
神经退行性疾病.abstract: In this study, we build EEG based graph model that uses frequency-resolved connectivity features, with Coherence, phase locking value (PLV) and phase lag index (PLI) in five frequency bands as multi-dimensional edge features. The model is used to classify Alzheimer disease (AD) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) against healthy controls (CN). This paper extends our earlier work on FTD with AD vs CN as the main new task, a feature ablation for it, and a joint analysis of both tasks. With leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) validation, the model reaches an accuracy of 81.13\% for AD vs CN and 76.06\% for FTD vs CN, which is competitive with the baselines reported with the dataset with far fewer parameters (159 and 282 thousand versus 170.5 million). Under the random cross-validation setting used for the DICE-net model, our model has a comparable accuracy for FTD and a lower accuracy for AD. Node and edge saliency maps highlight occipital and temporal electrodes, the Alpha band for node features and the Theta band for edge features, which is consistent with earlier EEG studies. In an ablation on the AD task, using all 15 edge features performed better than using a single connectivity measure or edge features averaged over the bands.

神经退行性疾病.title: Function-oriented microglial transcriptional scores in Alz-heimer's disease: resolving terminal functions beyond activa-tion states
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) staging based on amyloid-{beta}, tau, and neurodegeneration does not capture heterogeneous microglial functions. Existing transcriptomic scores indicate microglial activation or state similarity but do not resolve post-activation functions and are not directly comparable across scales. Herein, we develop a function-oriented framework comprising seven harmful-and seven adaptive-associated gene modules, selected from predefined mechanisms and direct functional evidence. Using SEA-AD micro-glia/perivascular macrophage nuclei, we compute do-nor-brain-region pseudobulk scores on a fixed P10-P90 reference scale and validate them against matched protein, activity, and tissue endpoints. H3 is related to cytokine/chemokine proteins; H4 and A5 are related to the same isoprostane readout in opposite directions; and A3 is related to dense-core plaque fraction. Benchmark comparison shows modest incremental fit but distinct out-come-specific information. In external GSE146639, eight modules remained FDR-significant, although harmful and adaptive arms are highly collinear; H7 and A2 are replicated in external proteomics. Downsampling, leave-one-gene-out, and alternative scoring analyses supports technical stability, and single-cell reconstruction supported a state-resolved basis. These scores summarize relative engagement of damage-related and adaptive programmes, enabling mechanistic comparison across donors and brain regions, but remain observational, are not intended for clinical decision-making, and require further validation.

神经退行性疾病.title: Network analysis of α-synuclein pathology progression reveals p21-activated kinases as regulators of vulnerability
神经退行性疾病.abstract: -Synuclein misfolding and progressive accumulation drive a pathogenic process in Parkinson's disease, yet many brain regions develop more or less pathology than would be predicted by connectivity alone, indicating that intrinsic biological factors influence regional vulnerability. Here, we combined whole brain mapping of -synuclein pathology in wildtype mice 3 days to 9 months after seeding with network diffusion modeling based on anatomical connectivity to derive quantitative measures of regional vulnerability. To identify molecular drivers of this vulnerability, we generated a brain-wide sPAtial Neuron Gene Expression Atlas (PANGEA) and compared regional transcriptional profiles with model-derived vulnerability scores. Vulnerable regions were enriched for specific cellular programs. Specific kinases were also enriched in vulnerable regions, leading to the identification of group II p21-activated kinases (PAKs) as candidate regulators of -synucleinopathy. Pharmacological inhibition of group II PAKs reduced -synuclein aggregation and protected against neuron loss in primary neurons, remained effective when administered after pathology initiation, and suppressed pathology in vivo. Consistent with these findings, genetic depletion of PAK5/6 also suppressed -synuclein aggregation. Together, these results establish a framework linking network-level measures to cellular mechanisms of selective vulnerability and nominate group II PAKs as promising disease-modifying therapeutic targets for Parkinson's disease.

神经退行性疾病.title: PODXL regulates the neuronal entry of α-synuclein aggregates
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Cell-to-cell transmission of -synuclein (-Syn) aggregates is a key event in Parkinson's disease (PD) pathogenesis, yet the neuronal surface factors that govern uptake of pathogenic -Syn fibrils remain undefined. We developed a flow cytometry-based CRISPR activation screen for modifiers of -Syn preformed fibril (PFF) uptake by human iPSC-derived cortical neurons. By interrogating 68 genes encoding cell-surface proteins prioritised by PD genetic associations, we identified podocalyxin-like protein 1 (PODXL) as a strong suppressor of -Syn fibril uptake. High-content imaging and PODXL cDNA overexpression confirmed reduced PFF uptake. Stable PODXL overexpression also reduced PFF-seeded pSynSer129 accumulation and uptake of structurally distinct recombinant and disease-derived -Syn fibrils. Conversely, shRNA-mediated PODXL knockdown increased -Syn PFF uptake, and analysis of PODXL domain-deletion and N-glycosylation mutants suggested that the ectodomain and N-glycosylation contribute to the PODXL-mediated reduction in uptake. Transcriptomic profiling further identified membrane metalloendopeptidase (MME) as a PODXL-responsive candidate mediator. MME activation and treatment with conditioned medium from MME-activated neurons reduced PFF uptake. Thiorphan, an MME inhibitor, partially attenuated the PODXL-associated reduction in uptake. Together, our findings identify PODXL as a neuronal brake on -Syn uptake and implicate its glycan-dependent surface properties together with MME-associated extracellular activity.

神经退行性疾病.title: Spatial proximity to AD pathology defines cell-type and genotype-specific characteristics in human AD hippocampus
神经退行性疾病.abstract: How amyloid-{beta} (A{beta}) plaques and tau phosphorylation spatially relate to cell response and genetic variation in Alzheimer's disease (AD) brain is currently unclear. We established a pipeline to concurrently annotate A{beta} and AT8 ptau pathology and cell-specific MERFISH expression profiles in human control and AD hippocampus. We characterized expression signatures in glia and neurons proximal or distal to A{beta} plaques, AT8 ptau-enriched neurons, or A{beta} and AT8 ptau in combination, and used spatially-defined transcriptional signatures to infer pathology-associated states in large snRNA-seq datasets lacking spatial context. We characterized variants from 120 gene loci associated with AD risk that affect cell-specific gene expression within local pathological contexts. Astrocyte APOE4/E4 expression was specifically suppressed in proximity to A{beta} plaques, whereas other APOE genotypes were unaffected by A{beta} proximity. Together, this analysis pipeline couples expression profiles in proximity to A{beta} and tau pathology, and implicates AD cis-gene variants with spatial sensitivity to AD pathology.

神经退行性疾病.title: A brain immune phenotype independent of Alzheimer's Disease associates with amyloid susceptibility and systemic inflammation
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Transcriptomic and proteomic studies have consistently demonstrated substantial molecular heterogeneity across patients with Alzheimer's disease (AD) and other neurodegenerative disorders, leading to the proposal of multiple disease subtypes. However, almost all previous studies have focused on heterogeneity within diseased cohorts, whereas comparatively little attention has been paid to the molecular diversity of neurologically healthy individuals. In the present study, we demonstrate that one of the most prominent transcriptomic programs characterized by a strong immune component previously interpreted as an AD-specific immune subtype is in fact a brain phenotype that exists independently of AD yet interacts with AD susceptibility and is selectively associated with amyloid pathology. The transcriptional effect of the immune phenotype exceeds that of AD pathology-induced changes and is accompanied by alterations of brain cellular compositions and a distinct systemic inflammation. Our findings suggest that part of the molecular heterogeneity observed in neurological diseases might arise from pre-existing brain phenotypes rather than representing disease-specific subtypes. These insights support a precision medicine approach for Alzheimer's disease, whereby individuals with an immune phenotype of the brain could be prospectively identified and monitored, enabling the application of targeted preventive strategies before substantial neuropathology and cognitive decline emerge.
